notes.title: You Suck At Parking® Complete Edition is Now Available
notes.content:
[b]Hey Parksters[/b]

The update you have finally been waiting for is here! You Suck At Parking® Complete Edition is now available for you and your friends to enjoy, packed with everything you could have asked for in this frustratingly fun drive. 

[h2]Completely Topped Off[/h2]
We’ve pulled out all the stops by giving you everything from previous seasons and more, so you can load on the fun however you enjoy your ride.

Complete Edition comes with:
[b][list]
[*] Single Player Campaigns
[*] Multiplayer Challenges
[*] Cross-platform, Online Matches with 6 players
[*] Hosted Private Matches with up to 8 players
[*] 4 Player Friends Parties
[*] All 270+ tracks unlocked
[*] Includes all 340+ cosmetics 
[/list][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/456e5cf30fca86c8ed12afcd96eed4d348e2ac74.png[/img]


[h2]Getting Upgraded[/h2]
If you already own the game, all you need to do to get the Complete Edition is update it by starting the game. While the game is updating, you can only play in offline mode until the update is complete. After that, you’re ready to burn some rubber and take this new ride for a spin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/0b9a2dc34d9bc1b92ccd64ff9950b14372de0bfc.png[/img]

[h2]Parking Support[/h2]
If you can’t cool your engines enough from all of this excitement or need some friendly support from fellow parksters, then stop on over to our [url=https://discord.gg/yousuckatparking]Discord server[/url].

There you’ll find everything from speedrunning challenges to meeting new friends to play against and a whole lot more. 

Happy Parking!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.11.05
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/cdaac418026888aeeea2fadcea7c623d04d08b8b.png[/img]

Hey parksters!

With the release of You Suck at Parking® Complete Edition, there have been a lot of changes!

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] Parking Lot Fully Loaded - All cosmetic items are available, but you need to have the right level. 
[*] Removed Daily Challenges
[*] Removed IAP’s and Real Money shop 
[*] Removed Parking Pass & Seasons 
[*] Removed Roadmap screen
[*] Modified achievements to work with the new Player Level system
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected time stats in the career screen, because time flies when you're having fun (Discord)
[*] The player name now properly displayed in golden color when fully parked in a MP match, even if hex codes are used to change font color on Steam, because gold is the new black (Discord)
[*] Fixed the issue where the start match button was grayed out if a spectator joined in and the host changed the biome settings, no more shady starts (/Private Match)
[*] Gamertag is now consistently shown in the leaderboards after expanding the leaderboard, let's get personal (UI)
[*] Fixed an issue where the inspect cam was resetting the parking spots until the player respawned a new car, no more parallel parking fails (Inspect Cam)
[*] The reconnection popup is now shown only once, no more nagging (MP)
[*] Resolved an "App not responding" error on quitting the game, the app is back on track (GPC)
[*] The leaderboard UI no longer disappears when toggling between friends and global leaderboards, because leaderboards are for everyone (Leaderboards)
[*] Addressed a loading screen issue where the player gets stuck and can see main menu tabs if disconnected during the match start countdown, we've cleared the traffic (Private Match)
[*] Player no longer sent back to the main menu if disconnecting and reconnecting on the round end screen, no more pit stops (Recon)
[*] Island unlock popup now appears when playing the game offline, because offline adventures need rewards too
[*] No more invisible cars in MP matches, they've got their paint jobs back (Discord)
[*] Fixed lobby member connection issues when the host selects a new lobby during a private match, no more lost connections (Private Lobby)
[*] The accelerator no longer gets stuck on low-speed input, it's full throttle ahead (Discord)
[*] Stripes pattern is now symmetrical on the hatchback, because symmetry matters (Discord)
[*] Addressed XP grant delays, you'll get your rewards on time (Discord)
[*] Fixed an issue where parking spots do not update in the inspect cam UI if the player parks and immediately opens the inspect cam, no more disappearing spots (Discord)
[*] Standard yellow car no longer collides with all the other cars on scrolling the player list in the round end screen, we've taught it some manners (MP)
[*] The mastery island popup no longer goes into the ground, it's staying afloat
[*] The parking lot UI is no longer visible in the main menu if the host fails to create a lobby while in the friends party, we've tidied up (Private Lobby)
[*] Inspect mode reset view is now consistently on the center of the map, because maps need a focus (SP/MP/Inspect mode)
[*] Spectate UI no longer remains during active gameplay after certain steps, we've cleared the spectators (Discord/Multiplayer)
[*] The previous level's name no longer seen in the pause menu on the current level, no more backward glances (Multiplayer)
[*] Host can no longer see other members of the party while the other members form a new party if the host disconnects and reconnects during an MP match, no more party tricks (Friends Party)
[*] Exiting Steam Overlay by pressing ESC no longer inputs ESC in-game, because we've stopped the double ESCAPE (Discord/UI)
[*] Names of friends who are in-game are now aligned in ascending order in the party UI, we've sorted things out (Friends Party)
[*] Career & Main Menu UI no longer overlap after certain steps, because UIs should play nice (Friends Party)
[*] Settings & Main Menu elements no longer overlap after certain steps, we've untangled the wires (Friends Party)
[*] Camera no longer jitters when holding down RMB on the mouse while spectating a player, steady as she goes (Multiplayer)
[*] "Default horn" text is now localized in all languages, because horns have their own language (LOC)
[*] Timer/fuel HUD and player list can now be seen after disconnecting and reconnecting during the lobby countdown, no more HUD mysteries (Reconnection)
[*] Resolved the issue where the parking spot font was supersized in the in-match player list (MP), no more squeezing in those parking spots!
[*] Fixed a soft lock issue related to level rotation with the level Babylon, no more scenic detours (MP), we've got a clear road ahead!
[*] Fixed the issue where the title freezes on a "failed to create new lobby" popup, no more icy reception
[*] Fixed the issue where the player stays invisible in the private match lobby if leaving and rejoining the same lobby multiple times, because invisibility isn't always an advantage (Private Match)
[*] Party no longer disbanded when pressing new match for certain players, the party goes on (Discord/GPC/Friends Party)
[*] Clipping through the ground on Frosty Toppings has been fixed, we've paved the way 
[*] The camera has finally learned to keep up from round 2 onwards in online matches (MP), it's no longer stuck in the slow lane.
[*] In-game player rank list is now visible in online matches, so you can see who's leading the pack (MP), let the race for glory begin!
[/list]

notes.title: You Suck at Parking®: Fantasy Ride
notes.content:
[h3]It’s a kinda magic[/h3]
Fantasy ride is the latest update for You Suck at Parking!

In Fantasy Ride, you'll explore the grasslands of the parking-verse through a fantasy lens. With new roads and colors, an exciting journey awaits! Grab your wizard hat and your best companions, and set out on your parking adventure. Speaking of adventure, no less than 24 new multiplayer levels are now in rotation in online mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/2845041643b008ba83c4f70287895543fdbc88e4.png[/img]

Do you wish to be an elf, a knight, a witch, or a potion maker...? The parking lot is full of new gear to create your own story in You Suck at Parking!

[h3]Private parties are now available[/h3]
Join forces with your friends across all platforms and battle for the crown! Private parties are coming with the Fantasy Ride update. Use a room code to invite your buddies and let the parking battle begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/82d21240f04e3844950b8af6fe09c36ad50e92ac.png[/img]

notes.title: FRIENDS PARTY IS LIVE: Time to party up and park
notes.content:
Hey Parksters, 

October comes to an end, and so does the wait: things got kicked up a notch with Friends Party. Now you can host your own party of chaotic fun with three other pals so you can romp around and partake in all sorts of shenanigans to get your kicks. 

[h3]Party Up[/h3]
The way Friends Party works is one player will be a host. That host will then be able to invite three Steam friends to join their “party”. 
Once you’re ready, your party will join a game of 4 other players (total of 8 players). The other players will be randomly selected and could be another party or just single players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/cd7c65516eff5ef0047ed31e45590d66272f9fe5.png[/img]

[h3]Public Parties[/h3]
Friends Party currently only lets you and your 3 friends play with other players. At the moment, hosting a private party, lobby or private play session with just your friends isn’t available, however, [b]this is a feature we plan on having later.[/b] 

[h3]No Crossing[/h3]
We spent a ton of time making sure Friends Party was as perfect as possible for your party parking pleasure.

As a means to make sure your party experience runs smoothly, currently, Friends Party doesn’t allow you to create cross-platform parties, but you can definitely host a party with your friends that are on the same platform.

[h3]Friend Finder[/h3]
If you’re afraid to make frenemies with your close buds, don’t worry. You can always [url=https://bit.ly/3iEK0CX]join our Discord[/url] to meet fellow parksters that share your concern and are looking to join a party! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/5806510a75770b8c8a89d8dec40e43c0efa02173.png[/img]

[h3]Parking Rewards[/h3]
We heard your feedback and implemented rewards for completing the campaign. You will get a cosmetic [b]reward for completing islands, biomes, and the whole campaign of course![/b] The rewards aren't random and we made a very nice selection to honor talented solo parksters. Launch the game today to discover what your parking prowess got you! 

Happy Parking!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/cdaac418026888aeeea2fadcea7c623d04d08b8b.png[/img]

We also fixed a truckload of bugs with this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the news items are not visible on the main menu
[*] Fixed an issue where changing text size causes the player's name to become blank in Main Menu
[*] Fixed an issue where the level preview screen UI is visible when the Get Ready popup is shown
[*] Fixed the parking spots count that was wrong on the HUD
[*] Fixed an issue where the round-end screen is not triggered and the players directly proceed to the next round
[*] Fixed an issue where debug text is seen on the purchase failed pop-up
[*] Fixed an issue where the audio settings do not apply to the Happy Volcano logo screen
[*] Fixed the quit button that should be present in the main menu if playing with a controller connected
[*] Fixed an issue where the game got stuck on the initial loading screen
[*] Fixed an issue where the Parking Pass & the Main Menu overlap after certain steps
[*] Fixed an issue where "Online Multiplayer" text is out of the box in the lobby screen
[*] Fixed an issue where cosmetics in release builds can be unlocked via hacks
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to Chaos Mode
notes.content:
For you Twitch streamers, we developed special features that allow you to connect with your audience for a whole new parking and streaming experience. 
Are you a Twitch user? Tell your favorite content creator about this! ⤵️

[h2]Chaos Mode[/h2]
Oh, you thought the game was hard? Imagine having random obstacles delivered on your path to the perfect park. Introducing: Chaos Mode! Based on the very latest Twitch SDK, we developed a very special integration that will make you hate and love your chat at the same time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/9f05b8328f35ad9ee9468b0d635e392f368bd10d.gif[/img]

[h2]Get started[/h2]
You can choose to activate Chaos Mode during your game sessions in the settings. Go to Settings > Others and authenticate using your Twitch account. Once you’re done, it will automatically create custom rewards on your channel that people can use with their channel points. You can toggle "Auto Log out" so the custom rewards don't stay on your channel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725386/f4aa2cd6c59043add0fbb8d66f7f61dbc878800f.png[/img]

Your viewers will have the power to send you either super nice or super mean presents using channel points. Will it be a mine or a speed boost? You know, even a jump pad can be an obstacle if you think about it… 

Chaos Mode is only available in the campaign and leaderboards are switched off to let your chat go crazy in this very special game mode. 

[h2]But that's not all[/h2]
Have your viewers with you wherever you go! Even if you’re busy parking cars, you will never miss a follow or a subscribe event. If one of those events is triggered, a small car with the name of your new community member will appear. They’ll be mimicking your every move for a short while. Who knew a hype train could actually park?!  A cheer alert also appears whenever a viewer uses bits. Your audience is with you, in-game! 

Need more info on Chaos Mode and its features? [url=mailto:contentcreators@happyvolcano.com]Email our marketing team here[/url] 💛

[i]This is a BETA feature so we're open to your feedback and are aware of an issue impacting the settings that can't be changed while in-game. We will fix this in the next patch. [/i]

notes.title: Roadmap Update
notes.content:
Hey Parksters, 

It’s release week and first of all, we want to thank you for playing You Suck at Parking™ at launch. We got to see some amazing streams and cool screenshots and we loved it! 

A lot of you requested more information about the roadmap of the game, and have raised concerns about its live aspect. We want to provide some milestones in this post today which hopefully will reassure you about YSAP’s future, and give some clarity about our ambitions for the game. 

[h2]September 28th[/h2]
[h3]First Level Rotation[/h3]
We have more multiplayer levels in store for you! Every two weeks, the 15 levels in the rotation will change to provide even more challenge and diversity for online players. Next up: we will [i]ice up[/i] some levels because winter is coming. 

[h2]October[/h2]
[h3]Friend Parties[/h3]
We’re currently finalizing this feature to allow for parties of 4 players with your Steam friends. It wasn’t ready to go for launch, and we want to make sure everything works properly before deploying it, especially for such a highly expected feature. It should be available next month. 
Please note that you won’t be able to create cross-platform parties. [url=https://www.yousuckatparking.cc/support/faq/crossplay]You can learn more about the cross-platform aspect of the game here.[/url] 

[h2]November[/h2]
[h3]All new Multiplayer levels and Seasonal bundles[/h3]
Exclusive bundles will drop for Halloween and Movember. You can also expect a whole bunch of new multiplayer levels that will test your parking skills like never before. 

[h2]December[/h2]
[h3]Season 2 and new biome[/h3]
The Parking Pass Season 2 will start this December. 
Around the same time, a whole new biome will be available, providing brand-new content in the campaign and new multiplayer levels. More on that later! 

Stay tuned! For world premiere announcements, join our [url=https://bit.ly/3iEK0CX]Discord server.[/url]

notes.title: Introducing You Suck at Parking™️: Alpha One

Hello everyone!

Prepare to take part in the world’s most extreme parking experience in You Suck at Parking™, as we are launching a special event of [b]Alpha Testing[/b] that we've called[b] Alpha One[/b]. In this test, you'll be able to try every level available at launch, over two biomes, grass and snow! Get your parking skills ready for [b]December 17th![/b]

Alpha One will feature:
[list]
[*] a truckload of levels
[*] Grass & Snow biomes overworlds
[*] Mastery Islands: unlock special islands in the overworld for more parking challenges
[*] Car Customization tool: pick your color and grab a beanie attachment, it's cold outside!
[*] Leaderboards for Alpha One Parksters only![/list]

[b]DISCORD CHALLENGE[/b]
We thought we could spice things up to get things even more interesting! Launching the Alpha you will have to pick a team and achieve goals in the game that we will reveal before the start of the test through Discord. You'll have access to a private channel for your team to organize and share tips and tricks to get on the road to success! The winning team will be rewarded with exclusive in-game prizes.

[b][url=https://www.yousuckatparking.cc/introducing-you-suck-parkingtm-alpha-one]Find more info on Alpha One and a FAQ on our website[/url][/b]

notes.title: FAQ | You Suck at Parking (but not at asking questions)
notes.content:
[b]Hey Parksters! Welcome to our official FAQ. It will be updated along the road, but if you have more questions for us, drop them on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/yousuckatparking]Discord[/url] or start a discussion.[/b]

[h3]Where and when can I play You Suck at Parking?[/h3]
For now, you can show off your skills on the demo, available right here on Steam! If you like it, please wishlist the game to receive our updates. The game will release on [b]September 14th[/b] on Steam and Xbox. The game is also being developed for PlayStation and Switch and is planned to release next year on those platforms. 


[h3]How long is the game? [/h3]
+100 levels will be available at launch: You Suck at Parking is a service game and we will spoil you with content for many months after launch! So technically it’s all up to you and how bad you suck at parking. 

[h3]Is it replayable? [/h3]
Whether you’d like to keep that spot up the leaderboard or to enjoy the chaos of Multiplayer, You Suck at Parking is highly replayable if you want to keep trying again and again and again..! Beat the clock, find your very own shortcuts and tricks: you're the hero of this parking story.

[h3]Can I remap controls? [/h3]
Absolutely, you’re able to choose your own driving style with personalized controls. 

[h3]Does it run at 60FPS? [/h3]
Sure does! You may need them to park smoothly. 

[h3]Does it support 4K? And ultrawide monitors? [/h3]
Yes to both!

[h3]Which engine is You Suck at Parking built on?[/h3]
The game is made with Unity.

[h3]Which languages does You Suck at Parking Support?[/h3]
English, French, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Simplified, and Traditional Chinese and Korean.

[h3]How big is the development team?[/h3]
Happy Volcano has a team of 20 dedicated and talented game devs. And a pug.

[h3]How can I provide feedback on You Suck at Parking?[/h3]
We have a [url=https://discord.com/invite/yousuckatparking]Discord server[/url] that you can join to ask your questions or leave feedback! Feel free to use Steam Community as well.

notes.title: Demo update II: visual overhaul and loads of fixes and updates
notes.content:
[b]VERSION: 0.108[/b]

Replays
[list]
[*] You can now watch a replay of your run in a level! Select 'Replay Editor' in the level end screen to start watching!
[*] There is a free camera, allowing you to get some great cinematic shots. You can also use the standard follow camera.
[*] You can save screenshots, and gifs from a replay.
[*] Be aware that replays are still in a highly experimental phase and may be full of bugs or glitches.
[/list]

Last Car!
[list]
[*] New gameplay mechanic: last car!
[*]When the timer of a level runs out, the level only ends once you have parked your current car.
[*]You cannot take a new car when you're out of time, and crashing your last car will also end the level.
[/list]

Gameplay & Features
[list]
[*] In-game UI when finishing a level now shows best time, amount of cars used and crashed.
[*] Using no more cars than there are parking spots in a level will result a perfection if all spots are filled.
[*] When exiting a level back to the overworld, the level select menu will be opened automatically.
[*] We've changed how settings are saved. If you played previous demo versions, your settings may have reset.
[*] NPC cars now try to keep driving after hitting obstacles and also have a life time.
[*] NPC cars now explode when hitting crash borders or magnets!
[*] NPC cars with intelligent behaviour will now drive up slopes and steer a bit faster.
[*] Fuel pickups can no longer fill up a car more than the starting amount of fuel.
[*] Added setting to turn vsync on or off
[*] Very Low and Low quality settings now disable car skid marks
[/list]

Visuals
[list]
[*] We're working on overhauling the visuals of the entire game and there's still much to be done.
[*] The body of your car will now tilt based on movement. Purely visual.
[*] Added billboards and more props to various levels and the overworld.
[*] Changed shader requirements of the grass. This should improve hardware compatibility.
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Added several more blockers in the overworld to prevent bad respawn locations.
[*] Fixed floating tree on Crowded House
[*] Fixed visual look of crashed/flattened bulldozers
[*] Fixed cursor vanishing in pause menu after closing the bug reporter
[*] Fixed level end screen sometimes appearing right after a restart
[*] Fixed a UI issue with the first button of a menu not being highlighted
[/list]

Optimizations
[list]
[*] We're putting more focus on making the game run better. We've made a few small improvements in this version already, but more performance enhancements are still to come.
[*] Improved performance of water rendering
[*] Improved performance of car skid marks
[/list]

Notes
[list]
[*] There is a bug with cars sometimes being stuck at spawn. We're investigating a solution. If this happens, try pressing respawn or restarting the level.
[*] The Replay Editor cannot have their controls customised yet. For azerty keyboard users, set your controls preset to azerty in the main menu for azerty-friendly controls.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update I: better camera, quality settings and small optimization fixes
notes.content:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new Dynamic Camera, which reacts to the movements and rotation of the car more smoothly.
[*]Added option to toggle between the (new) Dynamic and Legacy cameras in the settings menu.
[*]Added a fuel indicator for each car.
[*]The in-game timer now also displays milliseconds.
[*]The game will now indicate you can press the respawn button when being stuck or flying out of bounds in the overworld (level select).
[*]Replaced bad parking pop-up by an interactable "Badly parked" traffic sign.
[*]Added option to disable grass in the settings menu, to help improve performance.
[*]Added a fuel meter to the HUD.
[*]The HUD timer now also displays milliseconds.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bonus time not resetting when a level is restarted.
[*] Fixed "Out of fuel" text not disappearing when restarting a level.
[*] Possible fix for grass causing significant performance issues on specific devices. If you still have low framerate, try disabling grass in the settings.
[*] Fixed overworld props not having friction applied.
[*] You can now see through the balloon and treehouse.
[*] Fixed a few edge cases where respawning was impossible.
[*] Tweaked the level "Crowded House" to make it harder to avoid the bulldozers.
[*] Fixed in-game timer sometimes incorrectly displaying seconds.
[*] Fixed UI SFX not being affected by the SFX volume setting.
[/list]
